newsitem.title: USA: Amoco reports Texas City refinery upset.
newsitem.headline: Amoco reports Texas City refinery upset.

text.p: A valve failure caused an operation upset of a fluid catalytic cracker at Amoco Corp's 433,000 barrel per day Texas City, Texas refinery on Monday, regulators said.

Smoke was visible from the refinery and operation of the catalytic cracker and electrostatic precipitator were affected after a valve failed to shut at 0720 CST, the company said in a report to the Galveston County pollution control board.
The company did not release details on the operating status of the equipment to the agency, which tracks environmental impacts of emissions from local refineries and chemical plants.
An Amoco spokeswoman, citing company policy, declined comment. "This is part of day-to-day operations," she said.
Traders said Amoco was actively seeking spot gasoline barrels in the U.S. Gulf Coast market, pushing both spot and futures prices higher on Monday.
